title: M0: implementation foundation
description: Establish the implementation foundation per ROADMAP.md M0: uv-managed Python project (package agora, requires-python >=3.14,<3.15), pytest/ruff/ty gates, missing docs/architecture/README.md index with revision precedence, and an implementation note recording the packaging-location decision (standalone agora package here vs the handoff's in-Hermes namespace) plus the Python pin evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Clean checkout: uv sync succeeds; package imports; a small behavioral test passes via uv run pytest; ruff check/format and ty check are clean; all documentation entry points referenced by AGENTS.md resolve; no runtime dependencies.
close_reason: Foundation established: uv-managed Python 3.14 project with agora package skeleton and entry point; pytest/ruff/ty gates pass; architecture index and implementation notes added; milestone structure laid into Beads.

title: Replay acceptance
description: ROADMAP.md near-term package. Remaining I01-I16 invariants and the three exact end-to-end stories from handoff section 10.
acceptance_criteria: I01-I16 pass; three handoff stories pass; unsupported capabilities remain inert; social positive fixtures reject an always-silent implementation.

title: Dispatch and invalidation
description: ROADMAP.md near-term package. Leases, reservations, cancellation/supersession, UNKNOWN accounting, correction/invalidation, restarts. Handoff sections 5, 6.2, 6.3, 7.
acceptance_criteria: All eight crash checkpoints injected; relevant invariants hold; no automatic resend or disclosure refund after ambiguous delivery.

title: M3: restart-safe replay slice
description: ROADMAP.md M3. Full v0.2 synthetic vertical slice. Exit evidence: I01-I16, three handoff stories and fault checkpoints pass.

title: Views and discretion
description: ROADMAP.md near-term package. Authority bindings, scoped staged memory, the two fixed transforms, runtime producer-input coverage, NONE/ADVISORY/REQUIRED/HARD_DENY routing. Handoff sections 4.2, 8.
acceptance_criteria: Access-result variants, authorized abstraction, denied/conflicting access, forged lineage, clean regeneration, stale summary and private-to-public context changes have focused tests.

title: M2: contextual discretion and protected views
description: ROADMAP.md M2. Scoped social memory, provenance and selective review working in replay. Exit evidence: access/use distinction, derived restrictions and ordinary cross-context recall tested.

title: Whole-turn wiring
description: ROADMAP.md near-term package. Scripted main/review/perception ports, coordinator, ordinary CommitGate routing, fake sidecar/world. Handoff sections 2, 5, 6.1.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic traces for speak, react, quiet and timer-driven initiation; all effects cross CommitGate.

title: Contract and storage spine
description: ROADMAP.md near-term package. Canonical typed records with common header rules, canonical payload binding, virtual monotonic clock, versioned core/transport SQLite stores. Handoff sections 3, 4, 7.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid records rejected; ingestion survives crash-before-ack using two SQLite ownership domains.

title: M1: one deterministic end-to-end turn
description: ROADMAP.md M1. Smallest runnable whole-turn replay: event or timer, autonomous decision, fake effect or quiet outcome, without an LLM. Contracts owned by docs/architecture/v0.2/synthetic-replay-implementation-handoff.md.

title: Align tool configuration with data-processing conventions
description: Port the transferable tool/testing rules from ~/Projects/data-processing pyproject.toml: bounded dev-tool versions, pytest addopts -q, ruff line-length 100 with expanded lint select (E,F,I,UP,B,SIM,C4,TID252,RUF) and explicit format block, ty environment python-version. Excludes hatchling/src layout, 3.13 pin, vendor excludes.
acceptance_criteria: Gates pass under the stricter config: ruff check, ruff format --check, pytest, ty check; uv.lock consistent.
close_reason: Ported transferable tool/testing rules from data-processing: bounded dev versions, pytest -q default, ruff line-length 100 with expanded lint select and explicit format block, ty python-version pin. All gates pass; one test docstring shortened for line length.

title: M7: measured improvements and broader environments
description: ROADMAP.md M7 extension lane. Each addition (Clef perception, embeddings, context selection, richer effects, broader tools, new adapters, native provenance) enters only with its own contract and evidence per the roadmap table.

title: M6: autonomous live participation
description: ROADMAP.md M6. Agent speaks, reacts, initiates and stays quiet within standing capabilities; same identity/context/CommitGate contracts as replay. Exit: bounded live operation preserves identity, discretion and delivery rules.

title: M5: persistent live Discord observation
description: ROADMAP.md M5. Live user-account transport that journals events across core restarts; verify the pinned dolfies selfcord branch at implementation time. Exit: custody, session ownership, recovery and retention tested without Agora-authored social sends.

title: M4: local Hermes deliberation
description: ROADMAP.md M4. Replace scripted main/reviewer ports with actual Hermes and a local model; verify against the hermes-agent checkout (cloned at ~/Projects/hermes). Captured requests must match admitted envelopes. Exit: measured safety and social behavior, not a privacy certificate.
